abstract.p: This paper presents our system for Sub-task 1 in MAHED 2025 (Zaghouani et al., 2025) shared task: Text-based Hate and Hope Speech Classification. We propose a robust pipeline built upon the bert-base-arabertv02-twitter model, leveraging domain-specific preprocessing, hyperparameter optimization with Optuna, and a K-Fold ensemble strategy. This system ranked 4 th among all participating teams on the leaderboard. We discuss technical design choices, the results of ablation studies, and the impact of preprocessing and model selection on final performance.
